notes:
Snapshot: Mid-market B2B search SaaS (developer docs + support KB). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for prototypes then moving to Dedicated if perf/cost aligns. POC started 2026-02-20 focused on embeddings throughput + semantic search relevance.

Goals/targets: QPS 120 steady, peak 250; vector search p95 <50ms, p99 <80ms; overnight batch indexing ~1.2M docs within 6-8 hours. Cost sensitivity: wants predictable per-query economics, concerned about egress and cross-region charges.

Technical notes: currently testing with Pinecone + Weaviate (client-managed). Using a mix of chunked doc embeddings + hierarchical reranker. Early Hosted results: embedding throughput ~12k/sec (hosted), query latencies 60-140ms depending on vector store. Bulk ingest hitting client-side limits — need server-side streaming/batching. Redwood SE suggested Optimize tuning (batch sizes, KV caching) and Dedicated for sustained throughput.

Timeline (recent):
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE Jordan) — product overview, requirement capture.
- 2026-02-25: Demo (Ava SE) — Hosted API streaming, embeddings pipeline, sample SDK integration.
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff — ingest sample corpus ~300k docs; integration with Pinecone for baseline.
- 2026-03-02: Recorded call (Fireflies ff-2026-03-02-8421).
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up q/a with product lead — asked 'can you guarantee steady-state cost per 1M queries?'.
- 2026-03-11: Redwood provided initial perf logs and Optimize recommendations.
- 2026-03-12: Internal review; AE updated next steps.

Customer quotes / signals: "We need predictable unit economics before committing to Dedicated." "Once we validate ingestion window for 1.2M docs, we can talk committed capacity."

Open items / blockers: pricing for Dedicated (need banded options for 6/12/24mo); vector DB connector latency (target <50ms) — current third-party adds variability; legal needs SOC2 evidence and US-only data residency clause.

Next steps (short): Redwood to deliver Dedicated pricing sheet + POC perf matrix by 2026-03-15. Schedule security checklist call with Trust & Safety (legal + infra). Plan second POC run with server-side batching (expected uplift).

Artifacts: pricing deck and security scan in Drive (drive://redwood/pricing/spectra-foundry-2026-q1.pptx, drive://redwood/security/spectra-scan-2026-03.pdf). Gmail thread: thread-CAOz9JkV-20260304. Jira: RDW-3125 (connector), RDW-3198 (billing questions).
